scripts.build:circuit: HOME=$PWD/.nargo-home XDG_CACHE_HOME=$PWD/.cache sh -c 'cd circuits/vote && nargo compile'
scripts.gen:verifier: HOME=$PWD/.nargo-home XDG_CACHE_HOME=$PWD/.cache sh -c 'cd circuits/vote && bb write_vk --oracle_hash keccak -b target/vote.json -o target && bb write_solidity_verifier -k target/vk -o ../../contracts/src/verifiers/HonkVerifier.sol'
scripts.build: npm run build:circuit && npm run gen:verifier && forge build
